name: Medic Mayhem
detailed_description:
Medic Mayhem is a fast-paced action game where your ambulance will turn the tide of battle. Speed through chaotic toy battlegrounds to rescue wounded soldiers and deliver them to your field hospital. Once healed, soldiers rejoin the fight – and the side with the most saved troops wins!

Key Features:

• Intense Gameplay: Dodge obstacles, drift out of tight spots, and use nitro boosts to escape sticky situations.

• Fun For All: Enjoy singleplayer, local co-op, or competitive PvP battles against AI or friends.

• Dynamic Arenas: Battle it out across three unique maps designed for non-stop action.

• Medic Powers: Collect in-game powerups like the magnet boost or troop vacuum to gain an edge in the fight.

• No Language Barrier: No in-game text ensures you can enjoy playing no matter what your language is.

Throttle into Medic Mayhem and prove your skills on the chaotic toy battlefield. Can you win the war by saving lives?
